description: Transport Concurrency, Goroutine Lifecycle, and Synchronization Contract

goroutines_per_connection.reader_loop: 1 dedicated goroutine per WebSocket executing Conn.ReadMessage()
goroutines_per_connection.writer_loop: 1 dedicated goroutine or serialized mutex-guarded write pump per WebSocket

hub_primitives.hub_pump: Dedicated signaling hub goroutine (main.u8Z_Xk) managing client/agent event registration and dispatch
hub_primitives.synchronization: sync.RWMutex protecting device, client, and agent maps against concurrent mutations
hub_primitives.write_serialization: sync.Mutex protecting concurrent writes to individual WebSocket connections
